next_original: There are many dynamic feedback controls to cope with the disturbance in literature. The well-known integral action, which is a special dynamic feedback, is robust to the constant disturbance [23]. In [8] and [9], the harmonic disturbance is compensated by the adaptive dynamic feedback for the wave equation and heat equation, respectively. By using the high-gain technique, the dynamic feedback designed by the method of active disturbance rejection control can cope with the general disturbance [3,7]. Another well-known example to show the disturbance robustness of the dynamic feedback is the internal model principle. In [12], the disturbance generated by an exosystem is compensated by the internal model principle.

current_original: Since the dynamic feedback can make use of the historical information of the control plant, it can usually obtain better control effects than the static feedback. The advantages of dynamic feedback mainly embody on at least two aspects: the robustness to the disturbance and the treatment of the unstable system. This paper focuses mainly on the disturbance robustness.
